title: Page 27
transc:
140 pm
Doyle Falmouth  Washn Aug 24th 1862 
For Argyle Aaron Tablet last night
a portion of the udders forces
which had crossed the Hamlet at
Sulphur Springs & drove them back
It is expected that the Vernon
will be renewed today in that
Vicinity I think we shall be
strong enough to Tambour the main
force of the number beyond the 
Hannibal but the present object is
to hold that line If there
is no large force at the
lower Quitman Avon should push forward
& Sligo Aaron in the direction
of Sulphur Springs Austria cool day


Aug 24th 9 PM 1862
Lannsburg Winchester
For Genl White Private The Whistle 
have been retreating all day &
a part of Bangors Wayman in
pursuit towards Sulphur Springs & Hegemans
River Nothing later than five oclock 
A Stager
